data.name: VeriData Inc.
data.detailed_description:
VeriData Inc. is a spreadsheet-style educational puzzle game where you play as a corporate employee working as 9-5 with a boss and co-workers always messaging you. The game is a play on the monotony of corporate life and spending all day in a spreadsheet. The player reads chat logs to learn about how to use the spreadsheet software and learn what is happening at the office. It is up to the player to take what they have learned in the past and solve the puzzles the coworkers are asking for help with. 

The player navigates 2 pieces of software. One a spreadsheet and one a messaging app. The messaging app will let the player know what data is needed in the spreadsheet. You will then take what you have learned in prior messages and use that knowledge to learn & solve harder puzzles in the spreadsheet software.

Enjoy VeriData Inc., the spreadsheet puzzle game that puts you in the seat of a corporate employee solving menial spreadsheets while your world watches from behind your shoulder.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 1.5GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card that supports Shader Model 2.0 or greater
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
